title: praxis.requirements-baseline/1
description: The authoritative baseline a derived requirements package is checked against by `praxis requirements preservation verify` (REQ-PRES-001): the source repository and pinned commit, the source documents with the SHA-256 of their text, and the inventory of source requirements with their mandatory obligations. Hashes are lowercase hex SHA-256 of UTF-8 text with line endings normalized to LF. See docs/requirements-preservation.md.

commit.description: The pinned commit SHA the inventory was taken from.

upstreamPath.description: Path in the authoritative repository, when it differs.

requirementPattern.description: A .NET regular expression whose first group captures a requirement id from a line (a heading, bold paragraph or list item); every id it finds must be inventoried, and each such line also bounds the section before it.

heading.description: The verbatim line that opens the requirement's section: a markdown heading, or a bold paragraph or list item matched by the document's requirementPattern.

text.description: Verbatim source text; it must occur in the requirement's section.

tokens.description: Exact tokens (case-insensitive) that the mapped derived criteria must contain; each must occur in `text`. Required, non-empty, for kind `value`.

decision.description: The decisionId of the approval record that decides the conflict.
